production.notes: Survey PC 192.168.1.4. Applanix (WebUI) ~192.168.1.150 → UDP NMEA to pc_ip:udp_port. Set com to DCT positioning COM (Device Manager). Trimble 192.168.142.1 is usually GNSS into Applanix, not the bridge UDP source.

norbit_dct.notes: Bridge on boat PC: UDP listen 40810. DCT target depends where DCT runs: on boat PC 127.0.0.1:40810; on operator laptop (MikroTik PTP) 192.168.1.8:40810; Tailscale/ZeroTier boat StaticIp:40810. Applanix→boat:40810. COM=serial leg if used.
